documents.title: Critical edition introduction
documents.text:
Critical edition introduction — Mareth Scroll (fictional).
In this document "MS-MS" means Mareth Scroll. Mareth Scroll reports folio count of 283 for FY2024 under the original agreement. Mareth Logistics subsidiary reports radiocarbon median date (CE) of 1597 year for FY2024. MS-MS reports lacunae share of 10% for FY2024. Mareth Scroll reports quire count of 27 for FY2025. For Mareth Scroll, the meaning of the term "ordo" in book II is read as: a liturgical order of service. The fiscal year of Mareth Scroll ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Catalogue entry
documents.text:
Catalogue entry — Mareth Scroll (fictional).
Mareth Scroll reports folio count of 336 for FY2024 under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Mareth Scroll reports radiocarbon median date (CE) of 1296 year for FY2024. Mareth Scroll reports recorded variant readings of 2231 for FY2025. Mareth Scroll reports number of scribal hands of 3 for LTM to 30 Jun 2025. For Mareth Scroll, the meaning of the term "ordo" in book II is read as: a social rank within the community.

documents.title: Review article
documents.text:
Review article — Mareth Scroll (fictional).
Mareth Scroll reports lacunae share of 12.8% for FY2024. Mareth Scroll reports gatherings of 32 for FY2025. Mareth Scroll reports recorded variant readings of 1729 for FY2025. Mareth Scroll reports number of scribal hands of 2 for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025). "gatherings" has the same meaning as "quire count".
